author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Bare-track endpoint selection does not handle a nonnumeric current endpoint.
findings.consequence: If a user has typed an invalid draft year, a track click cannot reliably choose the invalid endpoint to repair it; for example an invalid `from` makes the distance comparisons fall through to `to`, so the click emits a `to` draft/commit and the parent later rejects or resets the range.
findings.evidence: `closestEndpoint` converts `props.from` at line 47 and then compares distances without checking `Number.isFinite`; direct callers preserve arbitrary draft strings from text fields, and existing tests cover invalid drafts but not repairing them through the shared slider.
findings.recommendation: Normalize endpoint candidates before comparing distances. If only one endpoint is finite, prefer the nonfinite endpoint so a track click can repair it; if neither is finite, fall back to the clicked side relative to the bounds or a deterministic default.
